title: Generic lisse stratum
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $F$ a sheaf of sets on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Suppose that for every integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] Noetherian affine scheme $S$ and immersion $g:S\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], there is a dense open $W$ of $S$ on which the iterated set inverse image of $F$ is lisse [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For every irreducible closed subset $T$ of $X$, there exist a proper closed subset $Z\subsetneq T$, a scheme $R$ and an immersion $r:R\to X$ with image $T\setminus Z$, such that the set inverse image of $F$ along $r$ is lisse. Irreducible includes nonempty.

proof.text: Put I = IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal T, Y = I.subscheme, and j = I.subschemeι. Mathlib range_subschemeι identifies the image with T; the proved upstream instance IdealSheafData.isReduced_subscheme_vanishingIdeal gives reducedness. The subtype irreducibility instance and isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced make Y integral. Choose an affine open U containing a point of Y. The standard open-immersion instances give integral and Noetherian U. This uses the proved upstream construction directly, not the stronger open reduced_induced_closed_subscheme theorem.

Apply the supplied hypothesis to U.ι composed with j. The dense open W is nonempty. Its image V in Y is open. Define Z as j applied to the complement of V; the closed embedding j makes Z closed in X. Injectivity of j and a point of W show Z is proper in T. Injectivity and the range formula show that W.ι composed with U.ι and j has image T minus Z.

Use the composition comparison for set inverse image to transport the lisse iterated pullback to the composite pullback. The local-constancy component is transported by Sheaf.isConstant_congr on each cover member, and finite geometric stalks by Finite.of_equiv applied to the fiber functor on the sheaf isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleGenericLisseStratum
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (hF : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral S] [IsNoetherian S] [IsAffine S]
      (g : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g],
      ∃ W : S.Opens, Dense (W : Set S) ∧
        IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets
          ((etaleSetPullback W.ι).obj ((etaleSetPullback g).obj F)))
    (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X) (hT : IsIrreducible (T : Set X)) :
    ∃ (Z : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X), Z < T ∧
      ∃ (S : Scheme.{u}) (g : S ⟶ X), IsImmersion g ∧
        Set.range g = (T : Set X) \ (Z : Set X) ∧
        IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets ((etaleSetPullback g).obj F)
